cards.card_text: Now Job's three friends hear about all of it: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite.
cards.verse_text: Now when Job’s three friends—Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite—heard about all this adversity that had come upon him, each of them came from his home, and they met together to go and sympathize with Job and comfort him.

cards.card_text: Now Bildad the Shuhite, one of the three friends who came to comfort him (Job 2:11), takes his turn.
Now Bildad the Shuhite, one of Job's three friends (Job 2:11), replies to Job.
cards.verse_text: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied: “How long until you end these speeches?

cards.card_text: Now Bildad the Shuhite, one of his friends (Job 2:11), replies.
cards.verse_text: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied: “Dominion and awe belong to God; He establishes harmony in the heights of heaven.

cards.card_text: So Eliphaz and his two friends, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite, go and do as the LORD told them.
cards.verse_text: For you have not spoken accurately about Me, as My servant Job has.” So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the LORD had told them; and the LORD accepted Job’s prayer.
